unresolved_added: The source has a Summary and visible title but no Abstract; official task wording is unavailable, so task coverage is reconstructed from the paper.
The assumptions of one gang, no emotional classification, time-irrelevant messages, and negligible data errors are asserted without diagnostics or sensitivity.
The graph representation says edges are messages in one place and people in another; direction, timestamps, duplicate identities, and topic assignment are not reconciled.
The cooperation-distance path is said to use CF edge weights even though the prose interprets 1-CF as uncorrelation; the actual distance transformation is ambiguous.
The query list of known people and assumed conspiratorial topics is not separated from model evaluation, creating label and feature leakage.
The EZ case has only ten people and the paper admits Carol may be falsely accused and Bob missed; no confusion matrix, uncertainty, or cost-sensitive threshold is reported.
The discriminating line is described as the largest adjacent gap measured by curvature, but no exact curvature equation, tie rule, or training/evaluation split is supplied.
Three conspiratorial topics receive equal weights without elicitation, normalization, or sensitivity analysis.
The large case uses seven known conspirators to argue reasonableness when those same labels help define the query and suspected group.
Adding Chris and Topic 1 changes edge weights and then evaluates the amended list on the same network, so the update is not an independent performance test.
Repeated names are distinguished only by denoted numbers, but the identity-resolution process and error rate are not documented.
The printed betweenness formula omits an explicit sum or normalization across node pairs and leaves disconnected-pair handling unclear.
Closeness is presented as inverse distance sum while the text calls it a sum; direction, normalization, and disconnected components remain unresolved.
Degree/strength notation mixes superscripts and the alpha=0.5 choice is arbitrary; the claim about whether high or low values are preferable is unclear.
Degree, closeness, and betweenness are equally weighted without scale normalization even though their displayed magnitudes differ substantially.
Table 5 ranks the smallest fusion values first while the prose says the highest fusion values identify leaders, creating a direction contradiction.
Alex is called a criminal leader by intersecting two internally derived lists; no independent leader ground truth or error analysis is shown.
The equal-topic-weight result is called unsatisfactory, but no quantitative baseline criterion is reported before switching methods.
Semantic-network construction is delegated to an AI system without a frozen ontology, extraction algorithm, relation confidence, implementation, or reproducibility record.
Topic importance combines three centralities without showing the combination formula, normalization, or mapping from importance to CD edge weights.
The TF-IDF pipeline omits tokenization, stop words, stemming, vocabulary construction, document definition, and zero-frequency handling.
The printed cosine numerator uses w_ij*w_jk while the denominator uses w_ik and w_jk, suggesting an index inconsistency retained from the source.
Unchanged criminal-group membership across related models sharing data and labels is internal agreement, not held-out robustness or accuracy.
The claim that a richer database will improve performance is not accompanied by a learning curve, resampling study, or independent corpus.
The biomedical application is justified by citations and mechanism analogy but is not tested on biomedical labels, costs, ethics, or domain baselines.
The paper admits AI-system variability and insufficient message samples but does not quantify either source of uncertainty.
The Summary claims a 12-member criminal group and robust refined results without a transparent label-independent benchmark.
No uncertainty propagation, global sensitivity, causal design, held-out validation, calibration, or decision-stability analysis is supplied.
The conclusion moves from non-prominent output and sample shortage to expected future accuracy and a bright future more strongly than the evidence permits.
Contents, References on pages 18-19, headers, table cells, chart labels, formula-only blocks, and cited wording are excluded from positive language evidence.
